d.title: Arslan Senki (TV): Tsuioku no Shou - Dakkan no Yaiba
d.en: The Heroic Legend of Arslan: Chapter of Reminiscence - The Blade to Retake the Kingdom
d.jp: アルスラーン戦記　総集編「追憶の章　奪還の刃」
d.synopsis: Arslan Senki (TV): Dakkan no Yaiba retells the events of the series' first 13 episodes, summarizing the events that transpired from Arslan's escape with Daryun, to their time in the Peshawar Citadel.
